subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers fix this narrowly by making explicit `heartbeat.session` win for event-triggered wakes while preserving documented Telegram `dmScope` defaults, or should Telegram DM default isolation also change as part of this issue?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing default Telegram DM routing would alter documented compatibility behavior for users who rely on main-session continuity.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked heartbeat wake fix so configured heartbeat sessions win, while leaving Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` pending a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same fix, accepting docs, migration, and upgrade impact for existing main-session users.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat scheduling work
options.body: Wait for the broader per-session heartbeat scheduling direction, leaving the current event-triggered contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked heartbeat wake fix so configured heartbeat sessions win, while leaving Telegram DM defaults controlled by `session.dmScope` pending a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter merged the heartbeat-session feature and is the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility/product split.
